name: System Audio Recorder
command:
#!/bin/bash
# Meetings Manager — dual-track recorder
# Captures MIC (you) + SYSTEM AUDIO (Zoom/Meet/Teams playback = other participants) in parallel.
set -u
cd "$PAPR_HOME/Jobs/095b6dbf-6096-433c-83d9-e7a66b8e459b" || exit 1
MEETINGS_DB="$PAPR_HOME/Jobs/40407339-ca0b-4650-a009-426201025e81/data/data.db"
if [ ! -f "$MEETINGS_DB" ]; then echo "ERROR: meetings DB not found at $MEETINGS_DB"; exit 1; fi

MEETING_ID=$(sqlite3 "$MEETINGS_DB" "SELECT id FROM meetings WHERE status='recording' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1")
if [ -z "$MEETING_ID" ]; then echo "ERROR: No meeting with status=recording found"; exit 1; fi

mkdir -p data/recordings logs
echo "$MEETING_ID" > data/current_meeting.txt
rm -f data/stop_signal data/stop_signal_sys

MIC_FILE="data/recordings/${MEETING_ID}_mic.wav"
SYS_FILE="data/recordings/${MEETING_ID}_sys.wav"
SINGLE_FILE="data/recordings/${MEETING_ID}.wav"
echo "Recording meeting: $MEETING_ID"

DEVICE_INDEX=$(sqlite3 "$MEETINGS_DB" "SELECT selected_device_index FROM audio_settings WHERE id=1" 2>/dev/null)
DEVICE_NAME=$(sqlite3 "$MEETINGS_DB" "SELECT selected_device_name FROM audio_settings WHERE id=1" 2>/dev/null)
MIC_PID=""; SYS_PID=""

if [ -n "$DEVICE_INDEX" ] && [ "$DEVICE_INDEX" -ge 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "MIC track: device [$DEVICE_INDEX] $DEVICE_NAME -> $MIC_FILE"
  /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg -f avfoundation -i ":${DEVICE_INDEX}" -acodec pcm_s16le -ar 16000 -ac 1 "$MIC_FILE" >logs/mic_ffmpeg.log 2>&1 &
  MIC_PID=$!
  echo "  ffmpeg mic PID: $MIC_PID"
fi

if [ -x ./recorder ]; then
  echo "SYS track: ScreenCaptureKit -> $SYS_FILE"
  ./recorder "$SYS_FILE" data/stop_signal_sys >logs/sys_recorder.log 2>&1 &
  SYS_PID=$!
  echo "  system recorder PID: $SYS_PID"
else
  echo "WARN: ./recorder binary missing, system audio will not be captured"
fi

if [ -z "$MIC_PID" ] && [ -z "$SYS_PID" ]; then echo "ERROR: Could not start any recorder"; exit 1; fi

echo "Waiting for stop signal (data/stop_signal)..."
while [ ! -f data/stop_signal ]; do sleep 0.5; done
echo "Stop signal received, stopping all recorders..."

if [ -n "$MIC_PID" ]; then kill -INT "$MIC_PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$MIC_PID" 2>/dev/null; echo "  mic ffmpeg stopped"; fi
if [ -n "$SYS_PID" ]; then touch data/stop_signal_sys; wait "$SYS_PID" 2>/dev/null; echo "  system recorder stopped"; fi

MIC_SIZE=0; SYS_SIZE=0
[ -f "$MIC_FILE" ] && MIC_SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$MIC_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
[ -f "$SYS_FILE" ] && SYS_SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$SYS_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "MIC file: ${MIC_SIZE} bytes"
echo "SYS file: ${SYS_SIZE} bytes"

if [ "$MIC_SIZE" -gt 1000 ] && [ "$SYS_SIZE" -gt 1000 ]; then
  echo "Dual-track OK: both mic and system captured"
elif [ "$MIC_SIZE" -gt 1000 ]; then
  echo "Only mic captured, copying to legacy path"; cp "$MIC_FILE" "$SINGLE_FILE"
elif [ "$SYS_SIZE" -gt 1000 ]; then
  echo "Only system audio captured, copying to legacy path"; cp "$SYS_FILE" "$SINGLE_FILE"
else
  echo "ERROR: No usable audio captured (mic=$MIC_SIZE sys=$SYS_SIZE bytes)"
  sqlite3 "$MEETINGS_DB" "UPDATE meetings SET status='failed', updated_at=strftime('%s','now') WHERE id='$MEETING_ID'"
  exit 1
fi

sqlite3 "$MEETINGS_DB" "UPDATE meetings SET status='recorded', updated_at=strftime('%s','now') WHERE id='$MEETING_ID'"
echo "Done. Meeting marked 'recorded' for transcription."
